summary: Master Branding Essentials for Business Growth. Learn brand equity management, architecture, and ROI measurement in this 5-day practitioner-led course. Enroll t
lede: Brand training gives marketing, communications, product and customer-experience professionals a structured way to shape and manage an organization’s identity. It addresses the practical task of keeping brand positioning and customer experience aligned through audience insight, value-proposition design, brand architecture, and consistent visual and verbal messaging. Learners also practice mapping customer touchpoints, auditing digital branding, evaluating awareness and sentiment, and planning brand growth.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the commercial identity and market positioning of their organizations.
audience: Employer Branding Specialists focused on talent attraction
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundation in marketing principles or at least two years of experience in a business development, marketing, or communications role. Familiarity with basic digital marketing metrics (CTR, conversion rates) is recommended but not required.
